messages:
ada: Quick sync for shiproom: proposing a fractional-tenant warmstart approach for the upcoming EU private model swap. Need per-tenant caps, micro-A/B probes, and explicit fallback ownership.
naveen: Sketch: select by tenant-hash -> 2% first wave, staggered waves with per-tenant cookie so users don't flip. Keep per-tenant rps cap 60.
lucy: Add multi-level soft fallbacks: lite-quant -> prompt-truncate -> reduced-max-tokens -> global-kill. Infra owns quant variants; product owns prompt templates.
ops-bot: runbook notice: any private rollout affecting >3% tenants requires oncall pinned and a rollback playbook attached.
ada: For safety we should run micro A/B probes during warmup: 500-session 50/50 from churn-sensitive tenants, quick sanity at 20m, full scoring at 2.5h. If hallucination delta > +1.3, hold.
naveen: Also recommend "gentle backoff": if tail-p95 > baseline*1.35 for 10m, decrement wave by 50% and initiate a 30m observation window.
lucy: Flag prototype (compact):
```
flags.fractional_swap.eu_private = {
  cohort_fraction: 0.02,
  per_tenant_cookie_ttl: "36h",
  per_tenant_cap_rps: 60,
  warmup_mins: 25,
  bump_policy: ["0.06 after 45m","0.18 after 3h"],
  micro_ab: {size:500, quick_check:20m, full_check:150m},
  fallback_order: ["lite-quant","prompt-truncate","token-cap-200","global-kill"],
  backoff_on: {metric: "p95", threshold_mult: 1.35, window_mins: 10, drop_fraction: 0.5},
  telemetry_tags: ["tenant.opt_in","rollback_reason"],
  approvals: ["product","security"]
}
```
safety-bot: safety rules: if safety-filters spike >0.4% or moderator hits increase >0.2% over baseline in micro AB, auto-hold and ping safety@redwood.
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-preflight at 1825054440. Failure -> hold + notify #eng-oncall.
ada: Small nuance: for EU private we cannot route outside region; shadow and logs must stay in-region. Legal asked we surface opt-in consent in the shiproom summary.
naveen: Ownership: infra implements cookie/bump/backoff; product runs micro-AB and manual review gate; safety monitors hallucination/regression; security signs manifest before auto-bump.
ada: Action items:
- naveen: implement flag + backoff hooks (owner)
- lucy: prepare micro-AB prompts + scoring harness (owner)
- ops: confirm KMS preflight schedule + per-tenant cap enforcement (owner)
- safety-bot: finalize auto-hold thresholds and notify list (owner)
Timeline: KMS preflight 1825054440, warmup 25m, quick micro-AB sanity at +20m, first bump at +45m, full micro-AB eval at +150m.
ada: If no objections to 2%->6%->18% cadence and backoff rule, thumbs up.
naveen: :thumbsup:
lucy: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security
ada: Closing and moving this into shiproom notes. Reopen here if approvals or KMS preflight change.
